claims: You can build your own Jarvis in one weekend with nine steps; 'by Sunday night you'll have a real Jarvis'
You do not need to build a model, just connect pieces: home, harness, model, context, memory, skills, tools, channels, interface
Without a harness 'it's just a chatbot'
You are not locked into any model; swap the brain anytime
how_to_steps: Step 1: give it a home — old laptop, Mac Mini, or cloud server
Step 2: install an agentic harness (Hermes Agent)
Step 3: choose the model (Claude, Codex, Gemini)
Step 4: teach it who you are, what you do, how your business works
Step 6: add skills for specific jobs ('built once, used forever; skills compound')
Step 7: connect tools — email & calendar, documents, browser
Step 8: connect channels — Slack, Telegram, iMessage; add Hermes Voice (ElevenLabs)
Step 9: build a custom interface with Claude Design and wire Hermes Voice to it
on_screen_only: Step cards with sub-bullets, e.g. 'STEP 2 Install an Agentic Harness: Hermes Agent — turns a model into a real agent; Runs the loop — plans, acts, checks its own work; The engine — everything else plugs into this'
'STEP 3 Choose the Model: Claude — reasoning and judgment; Codex — code-heavy workflows; Gemini — long context, multimodal. You're not locked in. Swap the brain anytime.'
'STEP 5 Give It Persistent Memory: Hancho AI — remembers past conversations; No repeating yourself; Gets sharper the more you use'
'STEP 7 Connect the Tools: Email & calendar — reads, drafts, schedules; Documents — pulls and edits your files; Browser — goes and gets the answer'
'STEP 8 Connect Communication Channels: Slack, Telegram, iMessage; Hermes Voice — powered by ElevenLabs; That British voice'
'STEP 9 Build the Jarvis Interface: Claude Design — build a custom interface; Connect Hermes Voice; Just like Iron Man'
Lower-third tags: THE ENGINE, NOT LOCKED IN, IT REMEMBERS, SKILL STACK, TOOLS ONLINE, IT TALKS BACK, JARVIS ONLINE

relevance.why: The layered architecture (harness, model, memory, skills, tools, channels) is the same shape as the founder's GOOSE/Claude Code setup, so it is a useful checklist. But it is a 488k-view funnel with no demo of anything working.

implement_score.why: Founder already has most layers via Claude Code + skills + MCP connectors. Only novel items are a Telegram/Slack channel and voice. Hermes Agent and Hancho AI are unverified dependencies; do not rebuild the stack around them.

verify: Hermes Agent — is this Nous Research's open-source agent framework, and is it production-usable?
Hancho AI — does it exist, pricing, maintained?
'Claude Design' — is this an Anthropic product or the creator's name for Claude artifacts/Claude Code frontend?
Is a 'weekend' realistic or is the course the actual product?
